liquid_glass_positioning: L5 governance/evidence output inside Live Pulse/Risk & Action or admin governance, not a third Arrival door.

improvement_items.title: Formalize Finance vs MDO target wording in all release notes
improvement_items.description: Add metric-definition governance check for all cards that compare R04 Finance actuals to R02 MDO targets.
improvement_items.expected_impact: Prevent interpretation drift in executive discussions and audit exports.
improvement_items.rollback_criteria: Rollback if wording change causes mismatch with approved metric definitions or source lineage labels.
improvement_items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Do not add a third Arrival door; keep changes inside Live Pulse/Narratives progressive depth.

improvement_items.title: Tighten stale-source SLA for critical R-series reports
improvement_items.description: Run monthly source-owner SLA review for R18/R04/R02/R08/R36/R10/R32/R34 and block stale critical cards.
improvement_items.expected_impact: Reduce trust erosion caused by stale data and reinforce no-silent-fallback rule.
improvement_items.rollback_criteria: Rollback if source blocks prevent approved fallback-labelled Board/CXO cards from rendering.
improvement_items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Do not add a third Arrival door; keep changes inside Live Pulse/Narratives progressive depth.

improvement_items.title: Reduce blocked Quickball explanations for validated metrics
improvement_items.description: Review top blocked-answer patterns and add missing metric synonyms only where lineage already exists.
improvement_items.expected_impact: Improve explain-this-number success without weakening lineage gate.
improvement_items.rollback_criteria: Rollback if any Quickball answer uses a critical metric without lineage or confidence state.
improvement_items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Do not add a third Arrival door; keep changes inside Live Pulse/Narratives progressive depth.

improvement_items.title: Simplify Risk & Action evidence path for managers
improvement_items.description: Reduce first-click choices by grouping action queues, workflows, and notifications under one 'Act on risk' path.
improvement_items.expected_impact: Increase action conversion while preserving two-door, three-choice Liquid Glass constraints.
improvement_items.rollback_criteria: Rollback if users require more than three visible choices on an L2 screen or if action discovery drops in pilot.
improvement_items.liquid_glass_guardrail: Do not add a third Arrival door; keep changes inside Live Pulse/Narratives progressive depth.

decision_rules.may_release: approved item + evidence + owner + expected impact + rollout gate + rollback criteria
decision_rules.must_block: missing lineage, forbidden removed role, third Arrival door, silent fallback, or missing rollback criteria
